mappings.rationale: The all, latest and skip subtests evaluate at base+35 with a 10-second recurrence and MaxBatch=2. All asserts two work occurrences after one evaluation and four after a second at the same time, supporting bounded batches and retained backlog. Latest asserts nominal=base+30 and covered_count=4. Skip asserts one skipped work occurrence. Limits: skip does not check which nominal instants are recorded as omitted; all does not inspect individual identities or coverage; no actual downtime/restart is exercised. This is source-level evidence, not an observed test pass.

The test attempts and acknowledges an occurrence, closes and reopens the store, and checks that serialized status contains acknowledged and contains no verified state. Evaluating at base+21 must create exactly one return-review occurrence, supporting preservation of unresolved acknowledgement and a return watch across restart. Limits: acknowledgement is invoked directly without transport; status is checked by string matching; the test does not directly inspect the persisted deadline or assert an explicit possibly-executed classification. This is source-level evidence, not an observed test pass.

With coverage ending at base+100 and planning review scheduled at base+70, evaluation at base+70 must create exactly one planning-review occurrence. Renewal at base+71 supplies a plan digest and extends coverage to base+200 and review to base+150. Evaluation at base+101 must produce no fallback, and a database query asserts both updated timestamps. This supports review creation before expiry and effective renewal beyond the original coverage boundary. Limits: no restart or crash tests durability or atomicity; the test does not evaluate at the new review deadline or inspect next-period work publication. This is source-level evidence, not an observed test pass.

The allow, defer and coalesce subtests attempt and acknowledge the first occurrence, then evaluate the next nominal instant at base+10. Attempting the next occurrence must succeed for allow and fail for defer and coalesce while the first remains unresolved. After a verified report with an evidence digest for the first occurrence, the blocked attempt must succeed. This supports policy-dependent publication gating without treating acknowledgement as completion. Limits: attempts and acknowledgement are direct store calls, not transport delivery; the test does not assert coalesced coverage or omission records, validate the evidence independently, or exercise restart durability. This is source-level evidence, not an observed test pass.
